title: Update all Mac App Store apps
summary: Install all pending updates for applications installed from the Mac App Store. This keeps your apps up to date without opening the App Store interface.

steps.explain: Install all pending updates for Mac App Store applications.

rollback.explain: You cannot easily downgrade apps via mas. If an update causes issues, you may need to reinstall an older version from a backup or contact the developer.

warnings: Updating apps may require an active internet connection and a signed-in Apple ID.
